30K likes, 1,418 comments - hubermanlab on October 12, 2026: "Comment BRAIN FOOD & I will DM you a link to the full episode: How Food Choices Shape Memory, Cognition & Cravings | with Dr. Scott Kanoski

My guest on the Huberman Lab podcast out now is Dr. Scott Kanoski, PhD, Professor of Human and Evolutionary Biology and Neurobiology at the University of Southern California. 

We discuss how different foods impact memory and cognitive function as well as your cravings. 

We also discuss how GLP-1 drugs work to control hunger in the brain and body, the role of the gut microbiome, and the effects of artificial and low calorie sweeteners on hunger and satiety. 

This episode highlights how nutrition impacts much brain health and learning capacity and how our memory impacts food choices too.

Comment BRAIN FOOD & I will DM you a link to the episode. 

You can also find it on all major podcast platforms, 

Meanwhile, please put any questions in the comments section below, and as always, thank you for your interest in science!

@stanford.med @stanford 
#neuroscience #science #ciência #neurociencia #craving".
